q: The study of fluids at rest is called _____.
e: The study of fluids at rest is called hydrostatics. Hydrostatics here means the study of fluids at rest. Hydrodynamic: the study of fluids in motion.

q: The study of fluids at motion is called _____.
e: The study of fluids at motion is called hydrodynamic. Hydrodynamic here means the study of fluids in motion. Hydrostatics: the study of fluids at rest.

q: Pressure is defined as the force exerted normally on _____.
e: Pressure is defined as the force exerted normally on unit area. Unit area here means an agreed amount you use as the scale of a measurement. Unit volume: an agreed amount you use as the scale of a measurement.

q: In SI units, pressure is measured in _____.
e: In SI units, pressure is measured in pascal. SI writes every quantity as a number times an agreed unit.

q: The relation between pascal, newton and metre is $1 \text{ Pa} =$ _____.
e: The relation between pascal, newton and metre is $1 \text{ Pa} =$ $1 \text{ N m}^{-2}$. The physics in this sentence is built around $1 \text{ N m}^{-2}$.

q: The force in the pressure formula must be _____ to the surface.
e: The force in the pressure formula must be normal ($90^{\circ}$) to the surface. The same force on a smaller area means a larger pressure.
Pressure is a scalar quantity. Scalar here means a quantity that has magnitude only. Vector: a quantity that has both magnitude and direction.

q: Pointed nails penetrate the surfaces because for a definite force, the exerted area is too _____.
e: Pointed nails penetrate the surfaces because for a definite force, the exerted area is too small. The physics in this sentence is built around small.

q: Sharp knives can cut more easily than blunt knives because of _____ cutting area.
e: Sharp knives can cut more easily than blunt knives because of smaller cutting area. The physics in this sentence is built around smaller.

q: Elephants have four large flat feet so they _____ the pressure and are less likely to sink into the ground.
e: Elephants have four large flat feet so they reduce the pressure and are less likely to sink into the ground. The same force on a smaller area means a larger pressure.

q: In the FPS system, the unit of pressure is _____.
e: In the FPS system, the unit of pressure is pound per square inch (psi). The same force on a smaller area means a larger pressure.

q: In Meteorology, the unit of pressure is _____.
e: In Meteorology, the unit of pressure is hectopascal (hPa). The same force on a smaller area means a larger pressure involving pressure.

q: Standard Atmospheric Pressure is _____ atmosphere (1 atm).
e: Standard Atmospheric Pressure is 1 atmosphere (1 atm). The same force on a smaller area means a larger pressure.

q: The relation $1 \text{ atm} = 1.013 \times 10^5 \text{ Pa} =$ _____ millimetre mercury.
e: The relation $1 \text{ atm} = 1.013 \times 10^5 \text{ Pa} =$ 760 millimetre mercury. The physics in this sentence is built around 760.
$1 \text{ atm} = 1013 \text{ hPa} =$ 1013 millibar (mb). The physics in this sentence is built around 1013.
$1 \text{ hPa} = 100 \text{ Pa} =$ 1 mb. The physics in this sentence is built around 1.
$1 \text{ psi} =$ $6.90 \times 10^3$ Pa. The physics in this sentence is built around $6.90 \times 10^3$.
